title: PaymentSessionInterface
description: One interface presenting a PaymentSession (ADR-015). An interface is a presentation, not a financial flow: it carries an opaque reference to the session and never an internal account id, never a mutable destination, never an authoritative amount. A QR interface is rendered by the operator (the app never generates a financial QR). An interface MAY carry its own state but MUST NOT contradict the session.

type.description: The interface kind. STATIC_QR may allow an open amount and may be permanent; the destination is still resolved by the operator.

value.description: The presentable artifact — a URL (PAYMENT_LINK / DEEP_LINK) or a signed QR payload (DYNAMIC_QR / STATIC_QR). Carries only an opaque session reference, never an account id.

format.description: Representation of `value` / how a QR image is rendered. Operator-rendered for QR.

expires_at.description: Interface expiry. MUST NOT be later than the session expiry.

status.description: Optional interface-local state (e.g. a single-use DYNAMIC_QR becomes USED). MUST NOT contradict the session (cannot report PAID while the session is not).
